title: Unleashing the 2007 R63 AMG

scenes.narration: A seven-seater with 503 horsepower that reaches 60 mph in just 4.6 seconds? That's the R63 AMG.

scenes.headline: 2007 Launch
scenes.narration: Launched in 2007, it was the only minivan engineered by AMG, the performance division of Mercedes-Benz.

scenes.headline: V8 Engine
scenes.narration: At its heart is a hand-built 6.2-liter V8 engine generating 503 horsepower and 465 lb-ft of torque.

scenes.headline: Drivetrain
scenes.narration: Power is delivered to all four wheels, with AMG-tuned suspension enhancing its handling.

scenes.headline: Vs. Porsche
scenes.narration: The R63 AMG faces off against the Porsche Cayenne Turbo, offering 503 horsepower against Porsche's 500.

scenes.headline: Luxurious Interior
scenes.narration: Inside, wood veneer and perforated leather bolster seats merge luxury with AMG style.

scenes.headline: $85K -> $25K
scenes.narration: Originally priced around $85,000, used models now trade for about $25,000, reflecting a significant depreciation.
Why would AMG make a minivan? To offer performance without sacrificing practicality—six seats, luxury style.

script: A seven-seater with 503 horsepower that reaches 60 mph in just 4.6 seconds? That's the R63 AMG. Launched in 2007, it was the only minivan engineered by AMG, the performance division of Mercedes-Benz. At its heart is a hand-built 6.2-liter V8 engine generating 503 horsepower and 465 lb-ft of torque. Power is delivered to all four wheels, with AMG-tuned suspension enhancing its handling. The R63 AMG faces off against the Porsche Cayenne Turbo, offering 503 horsepower against Porsche's 500. Inside, wood veneer and perforated leather bolster seats merge luxury with AMG style. Originally priced around $85,000, used models now trade for about $25,000, reflecting a significant depreciation. Why would AMG make a minivan? To offer performance without sacrificing practicality—six seats, luxury style. So would you take this powerhouse minivan for a spin, or is it more than you need for daily driving?
